newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Central bank injects 454 mln dirhams at weekly repo.
newsitem.headline: Central bank injects 454 mln dirhams at weekly repo.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 454 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Friday.

The bank received bids totalling 3.996 billion dirhams and allocated 3.300 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 2.946 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 82.58 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on March 4, 1997.
